data.name: Muif
data.gender_notes: Muif is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'A-W-F', meaning 'to be pleased'. This name signifies the joy and delight that comes from being close to Allah. The name Muif carries the meaning “Delight, Joy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muif usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of Allah's blessings and love
data.etymology: Muif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delight, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muif total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
